status: Pushed to main, deployed successfully, and verified live.
features: Top-left settings gear: Show advanced payloads, Auto Jailbreak, Auto-Retry Jailbreak, Reload after a successful jailbreak, Barebone Jailbreak Experience.
Advanced tools and auto-retry default on, auto jailbreak/reload/barebone default off. Preferences persist locally. Opening Options pauses countdown.

Auto Jailbreak shares existing five-second countdown. Retry is bounded to one fresh countdown after explicit JB-THREW before any kernel-stage log. Stalls, crashes, kernel failures and uncertain outcomes never trigger retry.
Optional reload requires both AG done and handles defused, then returns to restored=1 without autostart. Barebone hides detailed logs; native runtime bytes remain unchanged.
Cache now, Update cache, Delete cache and Stop. Modern cache uses checksum-verified generations, retains old cache if update fails, aborts response bodies and deletes only this runtime namespace.
On PS4 AppCache, Delete disables automatic caching and explains OPTIONS > Settings > Clear Website Data; this browser operation also affects other hosts. No false programmatic-deletion claim.
Offline closure includes firmware-locked 14.02 loader page, sender ZIP, ELF-loader BIN and ELF, authored assets and settings. Cache download never executes payloads.
Native banner remains on chooser; sending and runtime execution pages have no third-party scripts.

verification.browser: Desktop/mobile settings inspected; Cache now, Update cache and Delete cache completed; bundled ELF-loader selection verified its SHA-256 without sending.
